Pakkai, Kongmoon, May 29.
Once again the folly of leaving an inland township unprotected has been amply demonstrated. Just as the Romans withdrew when their Empire was tottering to its ruins and left the ancient Britons to the tender mercies of invaders, so did the “Fook” garrison at Kamchuk (where Mr. Rasmussen was captured) depart for Canton to increase the strength of the hemmed-in Com district was attacked and that many houses were plundered but details are lacking.

text: The Canton-Kongmoon towboat had a narrow escape from a mine. It was near Ho Tong, not far from this port, when the mine blew up about 150 feet from the junk and her luanch.

text: It is stated that unless of sum of $250,000 is paid to the Government, certain lands and foreshore rights will be declared “national property.” People at Chekhom threaten a general strike in protest.
